Fluent in four languages, he was stationed in Europe, first in Karlsruhe, Germany and then in Orléans, France, where this image was made. This image embodies formal aspects and visual themes that he would continue to explore in the coming decades, particularly his love of capturing animals in motion, as well as his ability to utilize natural lighting for dramatic effect.
